title: "Read, and You Will Know"
author: James Baldwin
summary: 小威廉·琼斯逢事便问，母亲教他从书中寻找答案，他终成大学者。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1912 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: "Mother, what are the clouds made of? Why does the rain fall? Where does all the rain water go? What good does it do?"
paragraphs.zh: “妈妈，云是什么做的？为什么会下雨？雨水都流到哪儿去了？它有什么用？”

paragraphs.en: Little William Jones was always asking questions.
paragraphs.zh: 小威廉·琼斯总在问问题。

paragraphs.en: "I want to know," he said; "I want to know everything."
paragraphs.zh: “我想知道，”他说，“我什么都想知道。”

paragraphs.en: At first his mother tried to answer all his questions. But after he had learned to read, she taught him to look in books for that which he wished to know.
paragraphs.zh: 起初，母亲尽量回答他所有的问题。后来他学会识字了，母亲就教他去书里寻找他想知道的东西。

paragraphs.en: "Read, and you will know, my child."
"Who lives on the other side of the world?"
"Oh, mother, I would like to know everything."
"You can never know everything, my child. But you can learn many things from books."
paragraphs.zh: “你永远不可能什么都知道，孩子。但你可以从书里学到许多东西。”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, mother, I will read and then I will know."
paragraphs.zh: “好的，妈妈，我会读书，然后我就会知道了。”

paragraphs.en: He was a very little boy, but before he was three years old he could read quite well. When eight years of age he was the best scholar at the famous school at Harrow. He was always reading, learning, inquiring.
paragraphs.zh: 他还是个小男孩，可不到三岁就能读得很好。八岁时，他已是哈罗公学这所名校里最优秀的学生。他总在读书、学习、提问。

paragraphs.en: "I want to know; I want to know," he kept saying.
paragraphs.zh: “我想知道，我想知道。”他总这么说。

paragraphs.en: "Read, and you will know," said his mother. "Read books that are true. Read about things that are beautiful and good. Read in order to become wise.
paragraphs.zh: “读一读，你就知道了，”母亲说，“读真实可靠的书。读美好的、善良的事物。读书是为了变得明智。

paragraphs.en: "Do not waste your time in reading foolish books. Do not read bad books, they will make you bad. No book is worth reading that does not make you better or wiser."
paragraphs.zh: “别把时间浪费在无聊的书上。不要读坏书，它们会让你变坏。不能让你变得更好或更聪明的书，都不值得读。”

paragraphs.en: And so William Jones went on reading and learning. He became one of the most famous scholars in the world. The king of England made him a knight and called him Sir William Jones. Sir William Jones lived nearly two hundred years ago. He was noted for his great knowledge, the most of which he had obtained from books. It is said that he could speak and write forty languages.
paragraphs.zh: 威廉·琼斯就这样一直读书、学习。他成了世界上最著名的学者之一。英国国王封他为爵士，称他为威廉·琼斯爵士。威廉·琼斯爵士生活在将近两百年前。他因学识渊博而闻名，其中大部分知识都是从书本中得来的。据说他能说和写四十种语言。
